selection: Exactly 1,000 distinct Christian chart songs with dated popularity evidence between 1999 and 16 November 2026. Traditional hymns, hymn adaptations, medleys, title variants and ambiguous crossover repertoire excluded. Popularity dates are not release dates.
evidenceNote: Billboard archive evidence is supplied through Charts Database; radio popularity evidence comes from the original Cross Rhythms and WJTL stations. Progressions are condensed publisher or community references, not recording verification. Keys missing or in conflict are not guessed.
